title: Baron Geisler says he’s with his family, assures he’s 'well, safe'

blocks.text: Baron Geisler assured fans that he is doing well, saying he is currently spending time with his family and will soon return to the limelight for new projects. “See you all soon,” he said in a video shared on his Instagram page on Thursday, Oct. 1. “Soon I’ll be shooting a film. Hindi pa pwedeng sabihin kung sinong kasama ko.” In the clip, Geisler also laughed off what he described as “false news,” although he did not elaborate on what he was referring to.
